# Vendored contract artifacts

This directory is **generated** — do not hand-edit anything under here. It's a copy of the compiled
contract JS/ABI and the witness implementation from `packages/contract`, kept inside the SDK so that
`@veil-reputation-protocol/sdk` can be published to npm as a self-contained package without depending on
`@veil-reputation-protocol/contract` (which is never published — see its `package.json`).

Deliberately **not** vendored: the ZK proving/verifying keys and `.zkir` files. Those are large
(tens of MB) and are hosted separately (S3/CloudFront) and fetched at runtime via
`VeilConfig.zkArtifactsBaseUrl` — see the SDK README's "Required URLs" section. Bundling them here
would bloat every consumer's `npm install` for artifacts most consumers never touch directly.

## Contents

- `managed/veil-protocol/contract/index.{js,d.ts,js.map}` — copied from
  `packages/contract/src/managed/veil-protocol/contract/`, the compiled Compact contract (the
  `Contract` class, `pureCircuits`, `ledger()`, and all ABI types). Regenerated by
  `compact compile` inside `packages/contract` — see that package's `compile`/`test:compile` scripts.
- `witness.ts` — copied from `packages/contract/src/witness.ts`, the hand-written private-state
  witness implementation. Its relative import (`./managed/veil-protocol/contract`) only resolves
  correctly because this directory mirrors `packages/contract/src`'s layout exactly — keep it that way.

## Refreshing this directory

Whenever `packages/contract`'s circuits or `witness.ts` change, re-run:

```sh
bun run --filter @veil-reputation-protocol/sdk sync-contract
```

This is also run automatically as part of `bun run build`, so a stale vendor copy can't silently
ship — but committing the refreshed files after a contract change is still a manual step, the same
way `packages/contract/src/managed` itself is a committed, regenerate-on-demand artifact.
